The '''2010–11 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Kentucky]] in the [[college basketball]] season of [[2010–11 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2010–11]]. The team's [[head coach]] is [[John Calipari]], who entered his second season after posting a 35–3 record in his inaugural season.
